lines.t: Seven years with my stomach in knots
Blind in the fog, forgetting what I lost
Mud on my eyes and a veil on my head
Treading dark water, going down like lead
Everything I built turned to rubble and smoke
Choking in the mire till my own voice broke
I left the ninety-nine when the sky caved in
Walked through the wolves with a lantern in the wind
[Her]
(I couldn't even stand—)
Barely breathed a word—
I heard your heart through all the noise!
(I was scared to fall)
Didn't know You were searching
Yeah, I heard your heart through all the noise!
[Her]
(While everything was caving in!)
Everybody's screaming, running out of air
You whispered in the dark and I was already there
I heard your heart
Through all the noise!
You don't know how long I've been holding back the dawn
Watching the rot take a world that's already gone
I don't stalk my sheep like a wolf in the night
My hands still wear the scars—I never lost sight
Waited in the field while the thunder rolled loud
Listening for one breath underneath the crowd
[Her]
(I was scared to move)
(I was scared to fall)
Didn't know You were searching
(I was scared to fall)
Didn't know You were searching
Through it all
I can wait no longer—let the walls come down!
Like lightning in Your eyes when the veil hits the ground
Nothing else matters—only You right now!
I heard your heart through all the noise!
(I was scared to fall)
Didn't know You were searching
Yeah, I heard your heart through all the noise!
[Her]
(While everything was caving in!)
Everybody's screaming, running out of air
You whispered in the dark and I was already there
I heard your heart
Through all the noise!
I stumbled, I broke, felt the ground split wide
You wept—I was there. You fell—I was there.
The scales hit the floor, all my pride turned to dust
Don't you get it yet? I'm enough—I'm enough!
Like fire in the cold, like a flood in my chest—
All breath in our lungs, Our home. Our rest!
I was dead in my sin.
Now we're breathing again!
I heard your heart through all the noise!
[Her]
(You pulled me out of everything!)
Yeah, I heard your heart through all the noise!
I was dead in my sin.
Everybody's screaming, running out of air
You whispered in the dark and I was already there
I heard your heart
Through all the noise!
Through all that dark... You heard me.
Every single beat.
Welcome home.
